balls.text: Delhi have fought back in some style. Irfan punches this low full toss to left of mid-off
Swing and an edge. The ball flies through vacant slips and runs down to third man boundary
full pitched delivery outside off and its mishit to mid-off for a single
slings a full delivery well outside off but just inside the tram line. Again 154.5
this one doesn't climb all that much and Irfan can't connect with his pull shot. The ball flies over the middle, the keeper collects and under-arms a direct hit.
a sharp pacy bouncer and Irfan ducks. Speed gun says 154.5 kmph!
shortish delivery outside off, pulled to midwicket for a single
tries to heave this slower one but can't clear Shane warne at deepish midwicket. Fine responsible knock from Venu who has pulled Delhi out of trouble.
Super blow and neat stop from Taylor. It was swung away in style to left of deep midwicket where Taylor charged across, lunged out and put his left hand out to push the ball back into field of play
this slower one slips down the leg side for a wide
This is even better. Flamboyant six over extra cover. Ala raman Lamba. It was a full delivery outside off and Venu has smashed it over the extra cover boundary.
50 for Venu Supah knock this. And super shot this. He read the slower one and swung it over long-off
the slow bouncer this time, swatted away for a single
Rajasthan have Tait. Then they have a slew of slower-ball specialists. This one too is a slower one and goes past the attempted heave
Tries yet another slower one .. too many i guess and Venu wallops this over extra cover. Lovely swing of the bat
More slower ones. more mishits. Venu inside edges this along the ground to the keeper

Warner departs. Done in by the slower one. Warner went for the big slog-heave over midwicket but top-edged it. fine innings. Delhi were staring down the abyss but Warner has rescued them along with Venu
another slower one and this one skids across down to the leg side and hits the pad outside leg stump., Venu was going for the slog across the line
the slower one , full and outside off, sliced away like ajay jadeja. Over backward point
goes for the pull but the ball climbs on him and he mistimes it. Safe, though, as it clears midwicket
goes down the track, takes it on the full but hits it straight down to long-off
gets back to pull this to deep midwicket
pushes this one well outside off and Warner lunges out for the drive but plays so away from the body that he edges it to his body
back and across and cuts to cover
Crunched. 50 for Warner He went back and chose placement and timing over violence. he punched this through extra cover. neatly done
drops this short but gets it slide away, cut to extra cover
fullish and finally in the zone outside off, Warner stabs it out to point
full delivery, Warner gets under the ball. Too much under the ball but he clears mid-on and will get some runs.
overpitched stuff again and this time Warner doesn't miss out. he clears the front foot, stays crouched and whips this full delivery through to midwicket boundary
fuller and outside leg again, Warner tries to whip it but misses and is hit on the pad
Thump o rama! Another tripe from Tait - short and down the leg side and Warner crash-pulls it over backward square-leg boundary. Whack
poor delivery, short and down the leg side, Warner helps it along to the fine-leg boundary
Venu sashays down the track and swings this from around off to the midwicket boundary. Up up and over.
full, and straighter, driven down to long-on
quicker, just outside leg, Warner stabs at it and it runs off the edge to the off
rushes down the track for the big hit but is beaten in flight. luckily for him, he gets an edge and it flies through the unmanned slips
gets down the track to ease this to long-on
pushes this away for a single
goes for the yorker, ends up a inswinging full toss and Venu plays a lovely whippy on drive to midwicket boundary
shoves this in the air but it falls short of point
cuts in to middle, worked to midwicket
cuts in from outside off stump, pushed out to cover
moves away from the leg stump and the bowler follows him. Cramped for room, Warner stabs it in the air but no one there at midwicket region
full in length on the middle, on driven to long-on
goes for the pull but mistimes it completely,, the ball rolls behind square-leg
pulls this one hard but straight to deep midwicket fielder.
short delivery and Warner actually doesn't quite connect well with his pull shot but he gets enough wood on it and gets the placement right to collect a boundary to square-leg boundary
short in length, on the middle, pushed to mid-on region for a single
moves away to the leg and pushes it to left of mid-off for a single
a flat-batted whack but straight to mid-off
flattish, quickish leg break and Venu leans well forward to defend
drifts this full around leg stump line and Venu plays the paddle sweep
lot more slower, on a length on the middle, eased towards long-on
slower, leg break on the off stump line, defended to the off
on a length around off and Venu lunges out to unfurl a powerful sweep shot. Smack
the skidder on the off stump line, jabbed away to the off
around the off stump line, eased through the on side for a single
gets back this time to cut it to deep point
rushes down the track and smashes this delivery over long-on boundary. The back foot was lifted in the air at the point of impact
backs away to force this to left of sweeper cover
on the leg stump line, worked past square-leg
turns in from outside off, pushed to straightish midwicket
follows that with a really full one outside off, Venu tries to stab it away in some panic
ah! loverly! It was slightly short in length to beat the sweep and Venu goes back to defend but is beaten by the amount of turn
sweeps this but cant beat Botha at backward square-leg
gets well forward to nudge this to backward square-leg
works this behind square-leg for a single
Sharp lovely leg break from outside off. Warner reacts as it its a time bomb and prods so nervously at it. Inside edge on to his body
gets back to clip this from the middle stump line through midwicket
moves down the track and on drives to long-on
quicker, skids on, jabbed to short fine-leg
turns in from outside off, pushed back to the bowler
quicker one, on the off, chopped to backward point
just outside off stump, pushed out to cover
slower, on the off stump line, defended to the off
When in doubt, sweep. Venu gets two runs for the effort
Another one? Big appeal for catch by the keeper. It was a lovely leg break. Stunning delivery. it drifted in towards the leg stump, gripped, and spun sharply past the defensive poke. no edge.

Delhi are self destructing in style. Such Masochism. Naman Ojha rushes down the track to deposit Warnie over long-off but is beaten in flight and by the dip. The leading edge takes the ball to backward point. Shane roars.
leans forward to defend the leg break

Dravid takes another one and Warne strike first delivery. Ooh la la! It was the leg break from the leg line, the batsman went for the cut. Cramped for room. The ball flies off the edge and bounds off the keeper's gloves and Rahul reacts very quickly to pouch that.
slower and full, on the middle, defended back down the track
works this past square-leg and will come back for the second
that slower one again, on the middle, turned past square-leg
shorter in length, pulled away to deep midwicket
he keeps trying, he keeps failing. He wants to drive on the up but hasn't got it right. yet. This one too is mistimed in  the air but falls short of mid-off
length delivery on the middle, pushed to mid-on for a single
And now the yorker! Not quite at the blockhole, pushed out to cover
the bouncer to follow the slower and the batsman is unable to adjust quickly. he goes for a pull but is no position to play it.. the ball rolls away to the off
the slower ball, length delivery outside off, cut to point where a diving stop is made
goes for the big slamming off drive but can't beat mid-off
gets back and across but mistimes the punchy shot to point
full in length, moving in towards the pad and rolls away to the leg side
goes for the yorker, hits the pad on the full but it was sliding down the leg side, i reckon
Wicket no 2. Simple. The bouncer on the off stump line and Finch is late on it. The ball climbed on him and he can only manage to lob a simple catch to mid-on.
full in length, just outside off, driven to mid-off
shorter in length, pulled to long-leg for a single
fuller, outside off, Finch edges the off drive to the leg side
shortish delivery and Finch shoves it over midwicket.
The slower ones keep coming; Warner punches this to cover
yet another slower one from the stable of Trivedi, Finch goes for a slog to the leg side but is too early. again.
goes for the slower one but slips it down the leg side
short in length around off, turned to square-leg fielder
goes for another pull but is too early into the shot and it was a slightly slower bouncer. The ball hits the body and rolls away
tries the bouncer but Warner is ready and pulls it to backward square-leg boundary
lands on the length around middle and leg and moves in towards leg, Warner, who was cramped for room, manages to push it to mid-on
Crunched! It was a flighted delivery and Aaron cleared his front foot and swung that bat down in a fury. The ball sailed over wide midwicket and it kept going
goes down the track and jabbed it back to the bowler
around the off stump line, pushed back to the bowler
topspinner outside off stump, Aaron backs away and goes for a big lofted off drive but misses it
gets back to punch this one and it looked like just a tame single but it was timed so well that mid-on fielder couldn't reach it despite a dive and deep midwicket charged across to make a diving save
on the leg stump line, bounds off the pad to the leg side. Not sure whether there was any bat on it
gets across to defend this to the off side
walks down the t rack and across the stumps. the bowler pushes it down the leg side
leans forward to push to right of mid-on for a quick single
on the middle stump line, moving across from the leg line, defended on the back foot
stays back to push it to point fielder
full in length and on the off stump line, defended to the off side
full in length and outside off, slower pace and that puts off Warner who is too early into his forcing shot. The bat -face shuts and the ball rolls  back down the track
gets forward to push it back down the track

Spicy hot! in the zone outside off, holding its line, and the batsman hops into trouble. it was quite pacy and he ended up stabbing late. The ball went through the bat and pad gap and flew over the off stump. The speed gun says 157.3 kmph. Be afraid. Very afraid!
fuller and in the zone outside off, left alone

Tait has his revenge. The very next ball. Sehwag is quick to turn and walk away from the scene. It was a short of length delivery outside off and it came in a touch, nothing alarming but just a bit. Sehwag tried to create room by hopping up and went for his slash. Edge and Dravid pouches it at first slip.
Slap! It was a short of length delivery outside off and Sehwag rocks back, that front leg is lifted in the air calypso style, and he punches it through cover point.
pacy one, at the rib cage, Warner hops, takes the bottom-hand off the handle and jabs it to backward square-leg
Resounding slap. Taylor went down on his knee and slog slapped Dinda high over midwicket boundary.

fierce thump and fine effort from Warner at long-on boundary. Taylor smashed this to right of Warner who rushed across and lunged out with the extended right hand to push the ball back into field of play but couldn't
low full toss on the pads, clipped away for just a single. Lucky escape for dinda
walks across and chips the length delivery towards long-off
bangs it in short, gets up on his toes to defend that
fullish delivery, turned through to deep midwicket region for two more.
cuts in with bounce, dabbed to the off side for a single
extra bounce from short of length outside off and Taylor is beaten on the cut
pushes this to left of Van der merwe at cover for a single
yorker on the off stump line, dug out through point and by the time the deep fielder comes in, they get two
tries another reverse sweep but this time the short third man makes a fine diving stop
full delivery on the off ,driven to left of long-off where irfan makes a sliding save
Botha loves those reverse sweeps and breaks free here with a crashing reverse-swept boundary
on the middle, pushed through mid-on
quickish delivery outside off, cut away to deep point where there is a fumble . extra run
cuts in from outside off, cramps the batsman, who manages to stab it to the leg side
the slow bouncer outside off, tapped close on the off side and they rush across
full in length on the middle, pushed out to mid-on
slower cutter, pushed to mid-on for a quick single. dinda dashed forward but failed to pick the ball cleanly
in the channel outside off stump and the batsman is beaten, poking away from the body. Morkel goes up in appeal for a catch by the keeper but there didnt seem any edge
Knocked over! Rahane looked a bit scratchy today and is now gone. He went for an ugly across-the-line hoick and completely missed the full-length delivery.
tries to get down the track for the big hit but the bowler shortens the length and quickens the pace and Botha jabs it back down the track
quicker, pushed through to deep cover
drifts to the pads and rolls away fora leg bye
taps this to left of that fielder in extra cover for a single
slower, outside off, pushed out awkwardly to extra cover
quicker one around off, eased through to sweeper cover
tries to sweep this but edges it in front of him.
around the off stump line, pushed out to cover point
leans forward to work this from outside off to long-on
good delivery, bit of air, bit of spin and it gets a hesitant prod from the batsman. And also the edge but no slip and it runs away
gets back to steer this to deep point
gets back to nurdle this behind square-leg
stays back to punch this to long-on
stays back to steer this slow cutter to point for a single
the slower ones keep coming thick and fast, this one has been edged towards first slip, the keeper gets across to stop it
full and straight on the middle, pushed to mid-on
another slower one, this is fuller, eased to long-off
Thump. Irfan continues to bleed. He tries the slower bouncer and Rahane has pulled it to the cow corner
That paddle sweep. He decided early, reached outside off, turned his face away at point of impact but connected solidly. And well clear of short fine-leg fielder
slower one well outside off, chopped out to point
full and hint of inswing, pushed back to the bowler
fuller, outside off, squeezed out to backward point
gets back to defend the in cutter to the off side
low dipping full toss, driven down to long-on
short in length on the middle, defended to the on side
Pouched! It was a short of length delivery outside off and Menaria punched it on the up but straight to Sehwag at short extra cover
backs away outside leg, irfan pushes it outside off and he ends up mistiming it back to the bowler.
in the zone outside off, Menaria doesn't connect with his cut
Bye bye! Six more! Irfan tries a slower one but Ashok has not only picked it but has played a fierce pick-up shot, a thumping flick, and it just about gets over the jumping fielder at deep square-leg
slower one, full in length on the middle, defended back down the track
quickish low full toss, swatted away to deep midwicket fielder
on the middle and leg, worked through midwicket
slower, on the middle, turned through backward square-leg for two runs
quicker, on the off, on a length, pushed through to long-off
Murderous hit! he went down on his knee and has absolutely tonked this over midwicket boundary.
leans forward to drive towards long-on
outside off, on a length, bottom edged to the off
quicker, pushed to midwicket
Menaria rocks back , opens his stance and plays a powerful pull shot and sends the ball screaming over midwicket
gets back to push this to cover
pushes back to punch this to long-on
on the off stump line, steered to backward point
fetches it from around the off stump line and paddles it to fine-leg boundary. Van der Merve was up in appeal for the lbw there. hmm
dabs this to square-leg and after some hesitation he gets across just in time
leans forward to defend to the off side
it drifted in towards middle stump, Rahul backed away outside leg but it turned and that got Rahul thinking, doubting and he perished, trying to stab it. Edge and gone.
works this to midwicket
dropped by Chand at extra cover. Rahul got a leading edge on that, trying to work it to the on side and it lobbed over Chand who ran back and dived but couldn't hold on
on the off stump line, no turn, punched out to long-on for a single
quickish and shortish, punched out to extra cover
presses back to punch it but mistimes it to extra cover
gets forward to work this to midwicket
turn there! and it surprises Rahul who just about withdraws his bat away from the line. Nothing alarming turn, mind you
gets back to punch this past the umpire and to left of long-on
leans forward to play a lovely stylish on drive. Rahul stretches well forward and wrists this full delivery to wide long-on boundary
turns away a bit, punched out to extra cover
full and just outside off, mistimes his drive to right of mid-off
flighted full on the middle and leg and Botha plays the on drive this time. ala Rahul himself, well not so stylishly but pretty effective. It runs through wide mid-on
gets back again and punches this wide of mid-off for a single
slightly short and Rahul makes it even shorter by pressing back very quickly and cuts it from the line of  stumps through cover point
stands tall to clip this shortish delivery behind square-leg for a single
full in length outside off, run down to third man
leans forward to on drive to mid-on
fullish, straight, pushed back to the bowler
stays back to dab this to point, looks for a single but retreats
in the channel outside off stump, Botha shoulders arms
gets behind the line to nudge this to the on side
And the late steer to third man now. He jumped back to ride the bounce, opened the bat face and steered it deliberately
Lovely on drive now. Irfan tries the slower off cutter but Rahul picks it, glides forward and wrists it through wide mid-on
Thunderous! Rahul has absolutely crashed this. it was a full delivery outside off and he has lofted it cleanly over long-on
nicely square cut but its intercepted at point. he then suggests he should have played it late(r) and got the placement
stays back to punch this to mid-off
wide outside off stump, the ump extends his arms
Clatter! The middle stump has been knocked out. It was full and sliding in towards middle and Amit Paunikar played all around it. Ugly shot and he pays for it.
Beaten by the pace, beaten by the bouncer but hey, he gets a thick edge on the pull and will collect a boundary to fine-leg region
slightly slower and Rahul plays the square cut on the front foot. The fielder dives to his left at point to make a half-stop
just outside off stump, cut away to backward point
whipped away in some style. it was a full pitched delivery on the legs and Rahul creams it through midwicket

It missed leg stump. How? It missed the inside edge. how? It missed the keeper also, that we know how. It cut in, went past the attempted on-the-up drive and missed the leg stump. Naman Ojha dived to his left but couldn't reach it
slower, full in length, leans forward to defend
kicks up from short of length and jabbed away off bat and pad back down the track
banged in short, hops to defend it down to the leg side
leans forward, opens the bat-face and glides it to left of third man where Venu makes a neat diving stop
well outside off stump and Rahul shoulders arms
drifts to the pad and Rahul tries the leg glance, misses, but will collect 4 leg byes
full in length on the middle, pushed out to mid-on
moves in towards the pads and edged away to square-leg
wide again. Rahul cuts and makes contact with the toe end of the bat and third man rushes to his right to stop it
outswinger outside off and Rahul goes chasing and is beaten
short in length and outside off, cut away but can't beat point
Tonked! Rahul backs away a touch and pulls it over midwicket
wayward delivery well outside off. Very wide but its a no ball first.
swinging away from the off stump line, edged through to thirdman. Huge No ball, though. Free hit coming up for Rahul, who takes his guard
